subject: Request: community credits for OpenOnramp CI (trial top-up + extension)
messages:
From: Samira Noor <samira@onramp.dev>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.inference>
Cc: Peter Liu <peter@foundation.org>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: community credits for OpenOnramp CI (trial top-up + extension)

Hi Monica,

Thanks for making Redwood available to the OpenOnramp project — we use the hosted API for our CI test harness and a small grant of credits would let us keep the build and benchmark runs green while we finalize our grant cycle. Quick context: OpenOnramp is a volunteer-run OSS project (maintainers: 6) supporting onboarding flows for federated identity; our CI spikes generate ~300k tokens/week during heavier integration runs (tests + smoke generations).

Ask: is there a community maintainer credit or trial top-up you can provide? Ideally something that covers ~3 months of CI (estimate attached) and a two-week trial extension while we finish onboarding automation. We can make a short mention in our release notes and attribution page.

Attachment: oss-usage-estimate.xlsx (token breakdown + monthly projection)

Happy to provide any additional info or open a short form if that helps.

Best,
Samira Noor
Co-maintainer, OpenOnramp
https://openonramp.org
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.inference>
To: Samira Noor <samira@onramp.dev>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 12:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: community credits for OpenOnramp CI (trial top-up + extension)

Hi Samira — thanks for the detail and the attachment, this is helpful.

I'm looping in Karthik and Marissa from growth/billing so we can review the estimate and handle issuance. Two quick clarifying Qs before we move to approval:
- Do you have an account already in Redwood or would you like us to create a community-level coupon tied to an email?
- Can you confirm whether the CI calls include any private data from contributors (so we can confirm the right privacy note for the credit)?

If you prefer, we can approve a standard community credit bundle and share redemption instructions. Plan is to respond by Monday EOD.

—Monica
Head of Developer Growth, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: community credits for OpenOnramp CI (trial top-up + extension)

Thanks for the note, Monica. Reviewed Samira's estimate. Looks reasonable for a temporary CI top-up. Approve the following:

- Community credits: $1,200 (applied as a promo code redeemable within the OpenOnramp account)
- Trial extension: 14 days on the existing trial window, starting at redemption
- Expiry of credits: 90 days from issuance

Marissa — can you please generate the promo code in Billing, attach the approval PDF, and send redemption steps back to Samira? Put HubSpot ticket HO-89342 on the record. I’ll mark this as "community:maintainer" in the approval memo.

Attachment: credit-approval.pdf (signed internal approval memo)

—Karthik
Head of Growth Ops
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Samira Noor <samira@onramp.dev>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Issued: OpenOnramp community promo + redemption instructions

Hi Samira — happy to confirm we issued the community promo. Details below: 

Promo code: OPENONRAMP-CMT-1200
Value: $1,200 credit applied on redemption
Trial extension: +14 days applied at redemption
Expiry: 2026-07-19 (90 days from today)

Redemption: 1) Sign into your OpenOnramp account (or create one at https://console.redwood.inference/signup). 2) Navigate to Billing → Promo codes → Apply code. 3) Follow the on-screen prompts; the credit will reflect on your next billing cycle. I’ve attached a short redemption guide.

Notes: We documented this under HubSpot HO-89342 and marked it as a maintainer community grant. No PII requested or required for issuance. If you need a longer voucher window, we can do a short extension with a PR mention.

Attachments: redemption-instructions.md

Feel free to reply here if anything goes awry during redemption — copying Monica and Karthik for visibility.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Samira Noor <samira@onramp.dev>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Issued: OpenOnramp community promo + redemption instructions

Marissa — this is fantastic, thank you so much. I see the code applied in our account and the trial extension is visible. We'll schedule a short attribution in our next release notes and ping you the link when it goes live.

Appreciate the help — this will keep our CI green while we finalize funding.

Best,
Samira
